name: tech-debt-workspace
description: Interactive technical debt explorer for local codebases

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tech-debt/core && npm run build -w @tech-debt/web && npm run build -w @tech-debt/server && npm run build -w @hollyman/tech-debt
scripts.publish:packages: npm run build && npm publish -w @tech-debt/core --access public && npm publish -w @tech-debt/server --access public && npm publish -w @hollyman/tech-debt --access public
scripts.publish:cli: npm run build -w @hollyman/tech-debt && npm publish -w @hollyman/tech-debt --access public
